placements.note: Campus-grade placement: DESY published no coordinates for the PETRA experimental halls that were fetched; the marker is the DESY campus point. CELLO took the PETRA collision region that PLUTO had used.
placements.quote: PLUTO had already operated [32] at the precursor storage ring DORIS, and was replaced at PETRA in March 1980 by the newly built CELLO detector [33].

summary.plain: The CELLO particle detector at DESY's PETRA ring, installed in 1980 in the collision region previously used by PLUTO.
summary.technical: CELLO detector at PETRA (1980-1986), described in 'Cello - A New Detector at PETRA', Physica Scripta 23 (1981) 610-622.
